{{Top|leg}}
'''Tyrellian ale''' was a kind of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from the [[Tyrellia system/Legends|Tyrellia system]].

A few years after [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Tyrellian ale's price spiked all the way up to 200 credits a barrel during one of the yearly [[Grand Moot|Grand Moots]] on planet [[Yelsain/Legends|Yesain]] due to high demand and shortage of supply.
